Honest availability checks: tri-state results, RDAP .com, USPTO, state registries, npm scope

Availability, company and trademark scorers now return True (available),
False (taken) or None (unknown). Previously several returned "available"
whenever the check failed:

- trademark_us queried a TSDR URL that does not search marks and returned
  True on any error; it now queries the tmsearch.uspto.gov backend, keeps
  live exact word marks, and filters by Nice class (9/15/41/42 by default).
- company_name_us got 401 from OpenCorporates (a token is now required) and
  returned True; it now reads OPENCORPORATES_API_TOKEN and returns None
  without one.
- WHOIS errors returned True; they now return None.
- npm used www.npmjs.com, which answers bots with 403 (read as "taken");
  it now uses the registry API. PyPI uses the JSON API.

New: rdap_com (Verisign RDAP, also used as the second pass of dns_com and
dns_net), npm_scope, company_us_states (NY/CO/OR/CT open-data registries,
which include Delaware companies registered there), company_us_sec (SEC
EDGAR entities), domain_sale_status (parked/for-sale landing pages).
research_company now filters on the keyless company checks.
